english.note: This is the all-purpose choice when someone opens their mouth wide, whether from yawning, anger, or surprise.

examples.english: When they heard the news, they gape with their mouth wide open in shock.
examples.traditional: 佢一聽到個消息，就張大個口，成個人呆咗。
